products.name: CeraVe Moisturizing Cream (50 ml)
products.description:
Rich, non-greasy daily moisturizer for dry to very dry skin, in a travel-friendly 50 ml (1.69 oz) tube.

Formulated with three essential ceramides and hyaluronic acid to help restore the skin barrier and lock in moisture. Fragrance-free and suitable for face and body.

products.name: The Ordinary Glycolic Acid 7% Toning Solution
products.description:
Exfoliating toner with 7% glycolic acid that gently resurfaces skin for a brighter, more even, glowing complexion.

Use once a day in the evening on clean, dry skin and avoid the eye area. Wear sunscreen during the day while using exfoliating acids.

products.name: Farmacy Green Clean Makeup Meltaway Cleansing Balm (200 ml)
products.description:
Large 200 ml (6.8 fl oz) jar of cleansing balm that melts into an oil on contact to dissolve makeup, sunscreen and the day's grime.

Massage onto dry skin, add a little water to emulsify, then rinse. Leaves skin clean and soft without a tight feeling.

products.name: Rosadia Face Wash
products.description:
Gentle gel cleanser made with damask rose essential water, mandelic acid and evening primrose oil.

The pump bottle makes it easy to use morning and night; lather with warm water and rinse for fresh, balanced skin.

products.name: The Act Body Butter
products.description:
Velvety-smooth body butter rich with shea butter, orange oil, grape seed oil and mango seed oil.

Softens rough skin, nourishes dry patches and gives all-day moisture with a delicate, sweet and juicy fragrance.

products.name: Dove Go Fresh Cucumber & Green Tea Shower Gel
products.description:
Refreshing shower gel with a crisp cucumber and green tea scent and Dove's moisturising cream.

Leaves skin softer and smoother after one shower.

products.name: NIVEA Body Milk Nourishing Lotion
products.description:
5-in-1 complete care body lotion for dry to very dry skin, with deep moisture serum, almond oil and vitamin E.

Absorbs quickly and provides up to 48 hours of intense moisture.

products.name: Giorgio Armani Acqua di Giò Profondo
products.description:
A deeper, more intense take on the classic Acqua di Giò: a fresh aquatic fragrance for men with aromatic, mineral notes.

Comes in the signature blue gradient bottle.

products.name: Ralph Lauren Polo Black
products.description:
Warm, modern woody fragrance for men in the signature dark Polo bottle.

A confident evening scent that pairs fruity freshness with a smooth, woody base.

products.name: Dior Sauvage
products.description:
Fresh and spicy fragrance for men with a strong, lasting trail.

One of Dior's best-known scents: bright citrus up front with a warm, ambery dry-down.

products.name: Denim Low-Top Sneakers
products.description:
Low-top sneakers in light-wash denim with darker denim overlays, tonal denim laces and a clean white cushioned sole.

A casual everyday pair that goes with jeans and shorts alike.
